stem:
Cheyenne works 15 hours a week at the movie theater. She earns $8 an hour.
Which statement about her weekly income is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Her net income is more than $120.

options.label: G
options.text: Her gross income is less than $120.

options.label: H
options.text: Her net income is less than $120.

options.label: J
options.text: Her gross income is more than $120.
